patterns: Should I build a native app or a hybrid app using Flutter or React Native?
responses: It depends on your goals! Native apps offer maximum performance and deep hardware integration, while Hybrid apps (Flutter/React Native) are highly cost-effective and allow you to launch on both iOS and Android simultaneously. We provide free consultations to help you choose the best fit.

patterns: Which is better for my project: PHP or Node.js?
responses: PHP is excellent for rapid development, content management systems, and traditional web apps. Node.js shines in real-time, highly concurrent applications (like chats or streaming). We will analyze your project requirements to recommend the optimal backend technology.

patterns: Is WordPress good enough for a large e-commerce store?
Can I use WordPress for big ecommerce
responses: WordPress (with WooCommerce) is great for small to medium stores. However, for a very large-scale e-commerce platform with heavy traffic and complex integrations, we typically recommend more robust, custom-built solutions or dedicated platforms like Magento or custom Node.js/PHP architectures.
